comments.value: I can confirm that this issue is occurring for me, as well. The fix described above (importing a copy of the exported default bindings) works.
I've also run into this bug with my Index controllers on the latest VRChat version, and I fixed the bindings by doing the same thing.

details:
**VRChat version:** Tested and confirmed on VIVEPORT 2021.3.4 and VIVEPORT 2021.3.3p2 [`vive.htc.469fbcbb-bfde-40b5-a7d4-381249d387cd`], but this issue probably affects many more (if not all) previous versions, too.

If a user with Index controllers downloads VRChat from VIVEPORT and launches it, they will be unable to properly use their Index controllers, despite them being properly detected with the rendermodels properly showing up.

This is because the default Index controller bindings are missing from the VIVEPORT version (or otherwise fail to load in SteamVR), which instead causes SteamVR to fall back to the "Index Controller Legacy Defaults" bindings.

To fix this, import a copy of the default bindings JSON file and set them as the active binding in SteamVR for the VIVEPORT version of VRChat.

After activating the default bindings, the Index controllers work perfectly as you'd expect, equivalent to the Steam version.

I've published the missing default bindings to the Steam Workshop via the bindings editor, but it seems that other users' uploaded Steam Workshop bindings unfortunately seem to not actually be visible for non-Steam games, even with a stable vrmanifest `app_key` (`vive.htc.469fbcbb-bfde-40b5-a7d4-381249d387cd`).

As a result, you'll have to download the JSON file from https://pastebin.com/FLyuw7uj and save it as `%userprofile%/Documents/steamvr/input/vive.htc.469fbcbb-bfde-40b5-a7d4-381249d387cd_knuckles.json`.

Here's the code block to activate the binding in `steamvr.vrsettings`:
```
   "vive.htc.469fbcbb-bfde-40b5-a7d4-381249d387cd" : {
      "knuckles_250820_CurrentURL_legacy" : "vr-input-workshop://2601679296",
      "knuckles_250820_NeedToUpdateAutosave_legacy" : false
   }
```

For reference, if you want to load the JSON file locally, here's how:
```
   "vive.htc.469fbcbb-bfde-40b5-a7d4-381249d387cd" : {
      "knuckles_250820_CurrentURL_legacy" : "file:///C:/Users/your-username-here/Documents/steamvr/input/vive.htc.469fbcbb-bfde-40b5-a7d4-381249d387cd_knuckles.json",
      "knuckles_250820_NeedToUpdateAutosave_legacy" : true
   }
```

Let me know if you have trouble reproducing this issue, though it should be pretty easy to do so.
title: The VIVEPORT version of VRChat is missing the correct default bindings for the Index controllers
